The hedge fund held 102,266 shares of the finance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.03 million, up from 88,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Iconiq Capital Llc who had been investing in Apollo Global Mgmt Llc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.97 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.59% or $0.19 $32.09.
